svg.title: Eclipse BaSyx AAS SDK layered architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture for the Eclipse BaSyx AAS SDK: compliance tool layer, adapter layer (JSON/XML/AASX), backend layer (local file, CouchDB), utility layer, and model layer — each depending only downward on the layer below.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who uses the BaSyx AAS SDK and compliance tool?')
sendPrompt('What does the BaSyx compliance tool validate?')
g.text: compliance_tool/aas_compliance_tool/ — validate AAS files against schemas using SDK parsing logic
sdk/basyx/aas/adapter/ — reads and writes AAS objects in each format

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the BaSyx JSON adapter serialize AAS objects?')
sendPrompt('How does the BaSyx XML adapter work?')
sendPrompt('How does the BaSyx AASX adapter handle package files?')

g.text: sdk/basyx/aas/backend/ — persists and retrieves AAS object stores

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the BaSyx local file backend work?')
sendPrompt('How does the BaSyx CouchDB backend work?')

g.text: sdk/basyx/aas/util/ — traversal helpers · identification utilities · shared AAS tooling
sdk/basyx/aas/model/ — Asset Administration Shells · Submodels · Concept Descriptions
references · data types · submodel elements — pure domain; no I/O

svg.text: Strictly unidirectional — higher-level tooling depends on lower model · adapter · backend layers · no upward imports
